lessons_used: Predictions were generally too high in early tests, but several round 3 successes (adoption new_flow, home new_flow) were under-predicted.
sign_in hint changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
choose_path layout changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, choose_path redesign, and finish new_screen as each has only been tested once.
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign, finish copy, finish incentive, home wait_info, and sign_in copy, each having only 1 test.
home new_flow produced one winning test and one test with no clear effect, so evidence for a consistent effect is still thin.

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Account Registration Flow
candidates.change: Reorder the onboarding sequence so sign-in occurs immediately after adoption certificate confirmation rather than before path/pet selection.
candidates.why: Sign-in has a high drop-off rate (72.9% conversion, mean 567s) and users complain about pets missing after signing in again; letting users choose and create their pet first builds emotional attachment before asking for credentials.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion Profile
sign_in.body: Create or sign in to your account now so your newly adopted companion state is safely saved to the cloud.

candidates.title: Desktop Sanctuary Arrival Setup Flow
candidates.change: Insert an interactive desktop sanctuary setup screen during the waiting step where users configure arrival preferences while their pet generates.
candidates.why: The waiting step (home target) has the longest mean wait time (2336s) and high drop-off; providing interactive customization during waiting keeps users active.

waiting.headline: Setting Up Your Desktop Sanctuary
waiting.body: While your companion gets ready, set up its desktop arrival preferences.

new_sanctuary_setup.headline: Design Desktop Arrival Zone
new_sanctuary_setup.body: Choose where your pet first lands on screen and set default quiet hours.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Stage Layout Pet Naming Certificate
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a stage layout with pet mascot display and verified companion badge.
candidates.why: Adoption step has 71.8% conversion and 1017s mean time; a stage layout with clear visual hierarchy elevates companion emotional connection.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Record
adoption_certificate.body: Confirm your desktop companion's name and official traits before completing adoption.

candidates.why: Choose path drop-off shows an average time of 514s despite 8s median; a visual carousel helps users quickly understand available companion paths.

candidates.change: Add a cloud save active status badge and persistent account protection banner on the sign-in screen.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again; explicit cloud backup messaging addresses account persistence anxiety.

sign_in.body: Sign in to activate cloud backup so your pet's traits and progress are safely preserved across logins.

candidates.title: Photo Quality Guidance Tip Carousel
candidates.change: Add a photo selection tip carousel and hint text to the upload photos step explaining lighting and framing standards.
candidates.why: Support receives tickets reporting custom pet generation failures or incorrect appearances; explicit photo guidance reduces generation errors.

upload_photos.body: Select clear photos for optimal custom pet rendering results.

components.text: Tips: Well-lit front-facing photos yield best rendering accuracy.

candidates.change: Enable time estimates and desktop completion notification toggles on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home waiting screen exhibits a high mean duration of 2336s and 86.4% conversion; providing progress transparency reduces drop-off from long generation times.
